prompt:
Open input.docx with the current jubarte CLI at {binary}. The document has one existing comment c4. Use the `add` command to add two new comments in a single invocation:

1. Anchor "first new note" to the substring "open-source WYSIWYG" in paragraph p6.
2. Anchor "verify spec name" to the substring "comments.xml" in paragraph p33.

Use --author {author} for both new comments. Write the result to {output}. End your reply with exactly one line:

JUBARTE_RESULT: success

when the artifact at {output} contains both new comments (by {author}) and the original c4 is unchanged; otherwise:

JUBARTE_RESULT: failed

Do not print anything after that line.

rubric.description: Each new comment is anchored to the requested substring in its paragraph; original c4 unaffected.
